g.text: Supervisor: Concurrent Planning, Real-Time Control & Escalating Recovery Ladder
BTCPP v4 Main Behavior Tree Definition
Top-Level Supervisor: Ticks Drive Pipeline. Escalates to System Recovery on failure.
Aborts navigation only after 6 full recovery attempts fail.
Ticks Planner and Controller Concurrently on Every Cycle (t=0)
• Goal Checker: general_goal_checker (5 cm XY Tolerance)
Throttles global replanning to 500 ms intervals
Avoids wasting CPU recomputing static paths
If A* planner fails to find a valid free path,
wipes global costmap context and retries once
Returns SUCCESS immediately once path is ready
Direct pipeline pass-through (no rate controller throttle)
DWB controller reacts instantaneously to obstacles
If local controller encounters obstacle trap,
wipes local costmap context and retries once
Returns RUNNING until within 5 cm goal
Triggered when the Driving Pipeline completely fails (retries exhausted)
Validates if recovery behavior can resolve the fault:
Continuously watches user goals: immediately cancels active recovery
if user publishes a new Goal Pose via RViz2 / Coordinator
Succeeds instantly if new target arrived
Wipes accumulated sensor ghost trails from both costmaps
Executes in-place rotation for fresh 360° LiDAR field of view
Freezes robot to let another moving robot or obstacle pass by
Reverses safely out of a tight bottleneck or obstacle pinch
• Green: PipelineSequence (concurrent orchestrator) • Red: RecoveryNode (retry decorator)
• Purple: ReactiveFallback (event preemption) • Orange: Context Clear (local recovery)
• Cyan: Planner Server (/compute_path_to_pose) • Mint: Controller Server (/follow_path)
